content:
Returns the total number of assets in the network along with the number of assets that have not
been seen for the specified number of days.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
The UUID of the network object for which you want to view details.
integer
Return a count of assets that have not been seen for the specified number
of days.
Minimum value: 1
Maximum value: 365
